adjudication.evidence: Original observations show a single sharp step at index ~420 across N/E/U with no sustained platform or opposing return; P1 and P2 are isolated 1-day candidates with near-identical offsets, consistent with a single impulsive event (e.g., cycle slip or spike), not a temporary offset platform. No interior persistence or recovery is observed—residuals after subtraction remain noisy but do not indicate a stable displaced state. Physical motion continues smoothly before/after; no evidence of a genuine temporary platform.
